title: BALEINE Non Slip Rug Pad Rug Gripper for Hardwood Floors, Extra Thick Non Slip Mat Under Carpet (2'x3')

reviews.title: Great value and worth it!
reviews.body: Got a washable large area rug. Dogs run around and would scoot the rug with furniture on it. This pad is terrific. Allows rug to stay put and gives it some cushion. So happy I'm not moving my sectional and rug back in place a few times a day!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 22, 2026
reviews.author: Angie Tatum

reviews.title: Exactly What My Man Cave Needed — Zero Slipping, Super Durable!
reviews.body: I ordered this non-skid rug pad for my man cave, and it works perfectly. I put it under a rug in my detached garage, and it completely stopped any sliding or shifting — even with my dogs running around and all the foot traffic in the space. The pad grips the floor really well, adds a nice bit of cushioning, and makes the whole setup feel a lot more secure and put-together.It was super easy to trim and lay down, no weird smells, and it instantly made the rug feel upgraded. If you’re setting up a man cave, workshop, or any space where you don’t want your rugs sliding all over the place, this pad is an absolute win. Highly recommend!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on December 10, 2025
reviews.author: Joshua

reviews.title: Rug gripper was about 80% effective.
reviews.body: The rug was supposedly non slip but it still moved. This is a rug for in front of the shower to step out on. So I ordered this hoping it would solve the problem.  It helped a lot but the rug still moves some.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 3, 2026
reviews.author: M Laywell

reviews.title: It saved me from having to buy a new rug!
reviews.body: My rug is getting a little bit old, so the nonslip component of the bottom doesn’t work well. I like the rug so I just bought this to put underneath.. I trimmed off half of an inch and put it underneath and it works like a dream!

features: [EXCEPTIONAL GRIP AND STABILITY] Say goodbye to rug slippage with the BALEINE non slip rug pad gripper. Our premium rug pads are engineered with an advanced anti-skid technology that firmly grips both the floor and the rug. Enjoy peace of mind knowing that your rugs will stay securely in place, even in high-traffic areas of your home.

[OPTIMAL CUSHIONING] Constructed with a thickness that surpasses standard non slip rug grippers, the cushion grip offers enhanced cushioning and comfort underfoot. This extra thickness also provides an additional layer of protection for your floors, preventing scratches and damage caused by rug movement.

[EASY TO CUSTOMIZE] With its easy-to-cut design, you can effortlessly cut the rug pads 8x10 to fit your specific rug dimensions such as area rugs 8x10 and 8x10 area rugs. To clean, simply spot clean with a damp cloth or sponge to remove any dirt or spills.

[DURABLE AND LONG-LASTING] Crafted with premium materials, our rug pad gripper is built to withstand daily wear and tear. The high-quality construction ensures long-lasting performance, so you can rely on its gripping power for years to come. Invest in the rug grippers for area rugs for a durable solution that will keep your rugs in place for the long haul.
[BALEINE QUALITY COMMITMENT]: BALEINE stands behind the quality of our products. If for any reason you are not satisfied with your purchase, please contact us.
